item.title: Perugia, Perugia, Italy
item.description:
Chi siamo – HypesoundStiamo reinventando la fermentazione microbica grazie a una tecnologia brevettata basata sulle onde sonore. Il nostro approccio plug-and-play migliora significativamente la produttività di microalghe, lieviti e batteri, integrandosi facilmente in fermentatori e bioreattori già esistenti.

Siamo una Bio/Deep-tech startup in rapida crescita, alla ricerca di menti curiose, competenti e appassionate di innovazione scientifica. Se vuoi contribuire in prima linea alla validazione e all’evoluzione di una tecnologia destinata a rivoluzionare la bioproduzione sostenibile, potresti essere la persona giusta per noi.

item.title: Footwear Designer
item.description:
OXMAN is a hybrid Design and R&D company that fuses design, technology, and biology to invent multi-scale products and environments. The fusion of disciplines within our work opens previously impossible opportunities within each domain—allowing design to inspire science and science to inspire design.

At OXMAN, we question dominant modes of design that have divorced us from Nature by prioritizing humanity above all else (human-centric design). Although it is design that has caused this rift, we believe that design also offers the greatest opportunity to heal it.

item.title: Senior Biodesign Engineer
item.description:
Moderna Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Biodesign Engineer to join our innovative team developing next-generation therapeutic solutions using synthetic biology and advanced materials design.

About the Role

As a Senior Biodesign Engineer, you will lead the development of novel biomaterial platforms for drug delivery and tissue engineering applications. You will work at the intersection of synthetic biology, materials science, and medical device development to create groundbreaking therapeutic solutions.

Requirements

  • Ph.D. in Bioengineering, Materials Science, or related field with 5+ years of industry experience
  • Extensive experience in biomaterials design and characterization
  • Strong background in synthetic biology and protein engineering
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional technical teams
  • Experience with medical device development and regulatory requirements
  • Excellence in experimental design and data analysis
  • Strong publication record and patent portfolio

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of novel biomaterial platforms for therapeutic applications
  • Design and execute experiments to characterize new materials and biological systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate biological and materials components
  • Mentor junior engineers and scientists
  • Author technical documentation and regulatory submissions
  • Contribute to intellectual property development
  • Present research findings to internal and external stakeholders

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities
  • On-site fitness center and cafeteria
  • Paid parental leave
  • Annual conference and training budget

Why Moderna?

At Moderna, we believe that innovative thinking and cutting-edge technology can revolutionize medicine. Our mRNA platform has already transformed vaccine development, and we’re just getting started. Join us in developing the next generation of therapeutic solutions that combine synthetic biology with advanced materials design.

item.title: Paper & Coating Engineer
item.description:
Paper & Coating Engineer | Jobs at Notpla Limited

The Role

At Notpla we’re at the leading edge of sustainable innovation, creating natural alternatives to single-use plastic packaging that’s carefully engineered to create a healthier planet. Founded on the belief that nature knows best, we’re an innovative, ideas and action-oriented scale-up who develop and manufacture uncompromisingly natural packaging solutions from seaweed and plants.

As a Paper & Coating Engineer, you’ll be joining an innovative, fast moving and agile Formulation & Process team that pride themselves on their pivotal research and development.
